items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Joe Harris was on drums sometimes, or Wesley Landers. Bass player was Aaron Bell. Aaron played later on with Duke Ellington’s band. Good players. There wasn’t nothing wrong with that.

ctx.x: This guy named Wesley Landers, and he was Lester’s steady drummer. He played well, but this was his bit. You got to have your stuff together for the crowd, the show closer. He was a fine guy.
